title: Reading a rendered frame instead of trusting the code
summary: A built scene proves nothing until a frame is inspected at the distances the user will use; the check list covers what code review cannot see.
applies_when: before reporting a scene as finished
after any change to lighting, materials or camera

values.compare_against: the previous frame of the same view, not against memory

checks: the hero is identifiable at overview
nothing floats without support and nothing intersects what it should not
the light comes from where the visible sources are
interactive controls change what they claim to change
a failed check is reported as failed, not omitted
limits: an image check cannot certify physical accuracy
one frame does not prove motion correctness; motion needs a second sample or a difference image
